name: TinyZKP Pricing
summary: Self-serve proof receipt plans bill a monthly base plus usage by trace band. Verification is free. Compute is usage-based for long supported traces at $0.50 per million trace steps with a $0.05 minimum. Serious production buyers can scope a $5,000 creditable pilot or sales-assisted platform rollout.

verification.note: Verifier calls and failed verifier checks are not proof-generation charges.

plans.name: Free
plans.best_for: Evaluation, demos, and first agent integrations.

plans.name: Developer
plans.best_for: Production pilots where receipts are attached to one workflow.

plans.name: Pro
plans.best_for: Teams adding receipts to customer-visible automations.

plans.name: Scale
plans.best_for: Production services with many receipts and support needs.

plans.name: Compute
plans.best_for: Large supported state-transition traces, backfills, and audit packages priced by trace step.

commercial_packages.name: Production Pilot
commercial_packages.best_for: Teams that need one receipt workflow proven with a real verifier before committing to rollout.
notes: Credited toward an annual or reserved-capacity agreement if converted within 60 days.

commercial_packages.name: Platform Rollout
commercial_packages.best_for: Agent platforms, workflow engines, and marketplaces that want proof receipts as a native policy surface.
notes: MCP, REST, schemas, and agent policy rollout.
Receipt-required tool categories for high-value actions.
Support and spend-control review before launch.

commercial_packages.name: Reserved Capacity
commercial_packages.best_for: Teams where receipts are customer-visible, auditor-visible, or operationally critical.
notes: Reserved proving lanes or Compute planning.

buyer_guidance.agent_builders: Start Free or Developer. Receipt one high-value tool call and return the agent receipt envelope.
buyer_guidance.agent_platforms: Use the $5,000 production pilot when proof receipts should become a native platform feature, then move to a sales-assisted platform rollout if receipt policy becomes a product surface.
buyer_guidance.api_and_saas: Start Developer, then move to Pro when receipts are customer-visible or attached to production mutations.
buyer_guidance.finance_and_audit: Use Pro or Scale for recurring checkpoints. Use Compute for long backfills, reserve/liability traces, or one-off audit packages.
buyer_guidance.evaluation: Use the TinyZKP evaluation kit to decide whether one receipt workflow has a real verifier, economic driver, and go/no-go path before buying.
buyer_guidance.fit_finder: Use the Fit Finder when the buyer or agent needs a conservative first-route recommendation from workflow type, verifier, receipt placement, data boundary, trace size, volume, procurement, and current alternative.
buyer_guidance.roi: Use the ROI worksheet when finance or procurement needs avoided-cost evidence for manual review, support, prover operations, TinyZKP spend, and pilot payback.
buyer_guidance.enterprise: Use the TinyZKP enterprise path for reserved capacity, support commitments, and custom state-machine review.
